thread:
sara (customer-success): Quick heads-up: multiple EU onboarding projects show stalled embedding indexing after last night's backfill. ClearPath reported their trial demo is blocked. Need a short customer-facing status + RCA and a mitigation/comp offer we can send. Renewal-risk flagging for ClearPath.
amanda (cs lead): Can someone give a 4-6 line RCA + current ETA we can paste? Keep it non-technical but accurate. Include what we did and the compensation offer.
jon (eng): RCA for CS: last night's embedding backfill removed an internal safety throttle (recent scheduler tweak) which allowed the job to spawn too many concurrent shard workers. One EU node (node-gpu-24) hit transient disk pressure and retried aggressively. The combination led to elevated 5xxs and a backlog for a small set of tenants. Immediate remediation: paused the global backfill, killed retrying workers, cleared the node cache, and restarted a rate-limited backfill. Longer-term: reapply concurrency cap, add disk-pressure alerts, and adjust scheduler tests.
mike (ops): Status/ETA: paused at 02:15 UTC, resumed at 04:20 UTC under rate-limit (~25% throughput). Backfill progress is steady at ~40% of normal; projected completion for affected tenants ~16-20 hours. If we run a targeted warm-path reindex for a single tenant we can finish in ~1-2 hours (higher resource cost). Need CS approval to escalate.
amanda (cs lead): Draft customer note (please review, prefer "safety throttle" phrasing instead of config jargon):

"Hi <Customer name>,

We're reaching out with an update: during a scheduled embedding reindex last night, a recent change inadvertently removed a safety throttle which allowed too many concurrent tasks. One EU node experienced disk pressure, which caused retries and slowed completion for a small number of onboarding projects (including yours). We paused the reindex, addressed the retry storm, and resumed a rate-limited backfill.

What happened: a safety throttle was removed and a node experienced transient disk pressure, which together caused retries and a backlog.

What we did: paused the job, terminated retrying workers, applied per-shard rate limits, cleared cache on the affected node, and added temporary buffer capacity.

Current status & ETA: the rate-limited backfill is running and we expect your indexing to complete within ~16-20 hours. If you need demo-ready state sooner, reply and we can run a targeted expedited reindex (would finish in ~1-2 hours); we will cover the cost for trial customers.

Compensation: we are applying one week of complimentary Dedicated credits to your account to apologize for the inconvenience.

If you'd like a direct walkthrough, we can schedule a 1:1 office hour with engineering and CS.

Apologies for the disruption 14 Sara on behalf of Redwood Inference Operations"

sara (customer-success): That reads well. Jon, is the "safety throttle" line OK? We don't want to leak config details.
jon (eng): Yes. "Safety throttle" is accurate and high-level.
amanda (cs lead): I'll send this to ClearPath, Mingle Labs, and BrightLeaf and cc sara + jon. I'll note the optional expedited reindex and the applied 1-week credit. Send within the hour.
incident-bot: Incident logged: INC-2026-0499 2022-embedding-backfill-eu. Severity P3. https://incidents.redwood.ai/INC-2026-0499
mike (ops): Small operational note: if ClearPath requests expedited reindex, confirm and we'll run warm-path now; ETA ~1-2h. Otherwise we'll continue rate-limited backfill and monitor.
sara (customer-success): Hold on targeted runs unless customer asks. Amanda, please also update the customer-health dashboard: Impact=Indexing delay, ETA=16-20h, Credit=1 week Dedicated, Escalation owner=amanda.
amanda (cs lead): Done 14 message sent to ClearPath + the two others. Copy of outbound message posted to this thread.
sara (customer-success): I'll follow up with the AE and flag renewal risk. If the backfill slips past 20h or new 5xx spikes appear, escalate to P2.
jon (eng): Monitoring in place. I'll push the concurrency-cap fix in tomorrow's rolling patch window and follow up with an infra postmortem note.
amanda (cs lead): Thanks all. I'll log any customer replies and any requests for prioritized reindex here. :thumbsup:
